svg.title: From free-energy curves to a phase diagram
svg.desc: Panel a: free energy per atom against Ag fraction at 1.2, 0.9 and 0.7 times Tc. Above Tc the curve has one minimum. Below Tc it has two minima, and a dashed common tangent touches each curve at two compositions. Panel b: the tangent points at each temperature traced out as a dome in temperature against composition. Monte Carlo points and the exact lattice boundary, dashed blue, form a flatter dome.

g.inkscape:label: Free energy to phase diagram
g.text: tangent points of the curves in (a)
